checks.name: The default Studio scene creates a sidebar, fixed button and compact menu
The sidebar stays fixed and produces no hover, press, drag, or action
Button hover expands around its anchor, a horizontal pull deforms it, and releasing the drag cancels activation
Each complete button click fires once and switches between both optical backgrounds
The launcher animates into a vertical list with two separate hit rows
A nested leaf changes the background and emits its full path once
An outside press dismisses the reopened menu without choosing another action
Dragging a draggable launcher changes its menu anchor without activating an item
Both optical backgrounds use their stored pixels at interior and clipped edge samples
Public Button inputs independently configure a circle, capsule, and rounded rectangle
A clipped custom label preserves letter case and stays inside its own button
An identical prepared frame retains the existing UI art without stamping again
A stage mouse-down and release wholly inside a native strip stamp activates the button once
Native labels and icons stamp above the glass strokes and restored backdrop
The native sprite import starts its controls and delivers Button and Menu actions in a fresh host
